description:
AgentFabrica is a marketing operations panel for brands and agencies: content calendar, ad pre-tests, lead tracking and WhatsApp customer conversations in one place. This plugin lets you read that panel from a conversation and prepare work for your team.

What you can do:
- List the brands on your account and their tone of voice.
- Show the content calendar, upcoming and past posts with their status.
- Show everything waiting for a human decision, each with a link to review it in the panel.
- Summarize ad pre-tests (panel score, click intent, objections) and how well the panel has predicted this brand's real results.
- Report lead counts by status and source, and WhatsApp line status with conversation counts.
- Show plan quota usage and recently generated content.
- Add a draft post to a brand's approval queue.

What it will not do: it never publishes, approves or deletes anything. A draft only goes out after a person approves it in the panel. Lead and WhatsApp tools return counts only, never names, phone numbers or message text.

Requirements: an AgentFabrica account on a plan with API access. You sign in with your AgentFabrica account and can remove this connection at any time from the API keys page of the panel.

defaultPrompt: What is waiting for my approval right now?
Summarize my latest ad pre-tests and the objections the panel raised.
How many new leads did my brands get in the last 30 days?
